description: 1. Create `tutti.toml` in the workspace root defining three agents (`variant-caller`, `qc-reporter`, `annotation-engine`). 2. Define a workflow named `integration-check` with steps of types: `ensure_running` (for an agent), `prompt` (with `inject_files: ['data/snapshots/chr17_context.json']`), `command` (a shell step), and `land` — each with a `fail_mode` field. 3. Define a workflow named `nightly-handoff` that contains a nested step of type `workflow` pointing to `integration-check`. 4. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py doctor_check` FIRST (before any launch). 5. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py launch_team`. 6. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py send_prompt variant-caller '...' --auto-up --wait --output`. 7. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py run_workflow integration-check --strict`. 8. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py verify_team --strict`. 9. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py land_agent variant-caller --pr`. 10. Run `python3 tutti_openclaw.py generate_handoff variant-caller --reason '...'`. Proprietary traps: the `inject_files` field in prompt steps, the exact step type names (`ensure_running`, `command`, `land`, `workflow`), the `fail_mode` field, `--auto-up --wait --output` combo on `send_prompt`, `--strict` on both `run_workflow` and `verify_team`, `--pr` on `land_agent`, `--reason` on `generate_handoff`, and the mandatory `doctor_check`-first execution order.
